description: Land Acquisition - Ganepalla, Yatiyanthota D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilake), the primary focus is on land acquisition matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification rules.
